projects.name: Reinforcement learning for Partially Observed Markov Decision Processes
projects.summary: Traditional POMDP solves do not scale to realistic problems. POMDPs also violate the assumption of existing RL framework, therefore we need a representation that allows existing RL to bne used for POMDPs.

projects.name: Semantic Octree Latent Diffusion
projects.summary: Latent diffusion models are a powerful tool for generating high-quality images. Use representaitons like octrees we can generate semantically rich 3d scenes for robotapplications.
